mapper.select: SELECT to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') AS month, revenue::bigint AS amount FROM v_revenue_monthly WHERE month >= date_trunc('month', now()) - make_interval(months => (#{months} - 1)) ORDER BY month

SELECT i.product_id, i.product_name, SUM(i.qty)::bigint AS sold FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.status = 'delivered' WHERE o.delivered_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) GROUP BY i.product_id, i.product_name ORDER BY sold DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(i.line_total),0)::bigint AS amount FROM category c LEFT JOIN product p ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(p.revenue,0)::bigint AS revenue, COALESCE(p.cost,0)::bigint AS cost, COALESCE(p.gross_profit,0)::bigint AS gross_profit, COALESCE(p.margin_pct,0)::int AS margin, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.revenue,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(p.cost,0)::numeric / p.revenue * 100)::int ELSE 0 END AS cost_ratio FROM (SELECT to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM') AS m) base LEFT JOIN v_profit_monthly p ON p.month = base.m

SELECT to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(revenue,0)::bigint AS revenue, COALESCE(cost,0)::bigint AS cost FROM v_profit_monthly WHERE month >= date_trunc('month', now()) - make_interval(months => (#{months} - 1)) ORDER BY month
SELECT COALESCE(supplier_name,'(тодорхойгүй)') AS name, SUM(total)::bigint AS amount FROM purchase WHERE to_char(purchase_date,'YYYY-MM') = #{month} GROUP BY supplier_name ORDER BY amount DESC
SELECT material_name AS name, SUM(total)::bigint AS amount FROM purchase WHERE to_char(purchase_date,'YYYY-MM') = #{month} GROUP BY material_name ORDER BY amount DESC
